results.name: duplicates
results.message: Found 720 duplicate mechanism signature(s) across 720 distinct location(s). The same fault path appears more than once in the DEM, which typically happens when sub-circuit DEMs are concatenated without merging coincident mechanisms. Duplicate probabilities should be XOR-folded as p_eff = p1*(1-p2) + p2*(1-p1) (iterated for 3+), not left as separate entries.

results.hint: Hypothesis: mechanisms sharing a full signature in the same spatial boundary region suggest sub-circuit DEMs concatenated without XOR-merging; the correct probability is the XOR-fused value shown in the counter-example.
